naming_policy.exact_dat_match: Use the platform-specific No-Intro name only when the file payload matches the full DAT hash tuple.
naming_policy.no_dat_match: Keep the current identity and record the reason; absence of a DAT match does not mean corruption.
naming_policy.modern_package_without_dat: Use verified package metadata such as Title ID and official title; do not label it No-Intro without a matching DAT.

format_validators..zip: python zipfile CRC and member inventory
format_validators..nsp: PFS0 table and payload-boundary validation; no NCA decryption
format_validators..cue: resolve every FILE track relative to the CUE
format_validators..sfo: read TITLE, TITLE_ID, CATEGORY, APP_VER, CONTENT_ID

system_relationships.switch: Associate base, update, and DLC using Title ID family and record missing bases. Keep all members in one title directory.
system_relationships.psvita: SFO CATEGORY gd is an application, gp is a patch, and ac is add-on content. Require compatible product/title identity before grouping add-ons.
system_relationships.ps4: Use CUSA title identity to group a base PKG with its patch; verify package metadata before declaring compatibility.
system_relationships.psx: CUE/M3U and every referenced track form one set. Compare archives against extracted sets before treating them as duplicates.
system_relationships.multi_disc: Keep all discs and sidecars together. Never move a single track without the complete descriptor relationship.

classifications.game: Complete game image or installable game package validated for the correct platform.
classifications.update: Update package associated by product/title identity with its base game.
classifications.dlc: Add-on package associated by product/title identity with its base game.
classifications.mod: Translation, hack, patch, homebrew alteration, or replacement package; review separately and do not mislabel as an unmodified game.
classifications.media: Artwork external to a game package; inventory separately and check frontend references.
classifications.package_asset: Image, database, executable, or metadata embedded in an installed game tree; preserve with that package.
classifications.support: Emulator, configuration, firmware, BIOS, save, guide, or launcher; keep out of the game inventory and preserve.
